messages:
sam (PM): ok kicking off a short PRD intake thread for the tenant-specific acceptance matrix. need problem stmt, concrete goals, non-goals, success metrics, and an acceptance checklist. trying to keep this scoped for Q2 runway.
lee (Eng): happy to help. can we lock the minimum measurable metrics first? p50/p95 latency, 99p tail, and cost per 1M tokens for each tenant class.
morgan (Design): also need UX acceptance: routing surfaces in Console show tenant-level SLOs and clear fallback state. mock exists but not finalized.
ada (typo) -> ada (CS): ada (CS) here — customer ask: ensure per-tenant quality gates (eval pass/fail) tie to rollout. we have 2 early customers that will block without this.
kai (SRE): operational constraints: autoscale window, warm start cold GPU penalty, and cross-availability fallback must be explicit in non-goals/risks.
sam (PM): updated asks: 1) Problem: customers want deterministic rollout/rollback per tenant tied to evals and SLOs; current platform only supports global rollouts. 2) Goal: ship a tenant acceptance matrix that maps tenant class -> {latency SLO, quality gate, cost bucket, rollout policy}. 3) Non-goal: full per-tenant custom infra or per-tenant billing model. 4) Success metrics: fewer manual rollbacks, % of customer rollouts passing automated evals, latency regressions prevented.
lee (Eng): rough acceptance checklist proposal: - automated eval suite triggered on model version -> pass/fail baseline per tenant class - canary policy respects tenant matrix and chooses fallback model if fail - metrics surfaced in Console per-tenant and per-route - automated rollback on quality gate fail (configurable)
morgan (Design): UX checklist: - matrix UI with edit/save per tenant class - inline indicators for current model & last eval result - visible rollback/canary status and reason - compact CSV export/import for enterprise ops
ada -> ada (CS): ada (CS): edge cases from customers: long-context tenants (50k tokens), streaming clients that expect partial responses, and tenants with strict privacy (no data leaving VPC). these should be in edge case section.
kai (SRE): add SRE acceptance: - end-to-end test that simulates capacity fallback and measures <5% error delta - alerting runbook for when fallback triggers - no single tenant can saturate shared Dedicated pools without hitting quota enforcement
lee (Eng): quick sketch of an acceptance matrix snippet (put into design doc later):
```
{
  "tenant_class": "low-latency-saas",
  "p95_latency_ms": "120",
  "quality_gate": "eval_v2 >= 0.85",
  "fallback_model": "redwood-small",
  "cost_bucket": "standard"
}
```
sam (PM): that looks good. next items: assign owners and due dates. propose: - sam: consolidate final PRD and acceptance matrix draft (due 4/1) - lee: implementation plan + infra constraints (due 4/8) - morgan: final mocks + CSV schema (due 3/28) - ada: customer acceptance criteria / pilot list (due 3/25) - kai: runbook + SRE tests (due 4/8)
lee (Eng): noted. quick technical question — should quality gates be strict boolean fail or graded with thresholding and soft-fallback? we have customers on both sides.
sam (PM): prefer configurable — default to strict for Tier A tenants, soft for Tier B with notifications. add to acceptance: ability to configure gate mode per tenant class.
morgan (Design): one more: ensure audit log includes eval inputs + model hash for compliance.
ada -> ada (CS): ada (CS): we should surface a simple CSV import template to onboard customers' tenant classes quickly. i'll draft sample data with two early customers.
product-bot: Reminder set for sam (PM) to follow up on 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC
sam (PM): thanks everyone — i'll update the PRD draft in docs/ and ping when ready. if anyone has additional edge cases, drop them here or DM me.
